senses.gloss: m. (ἀναβάτης, contr. ἀμβάτης) prop. rider, traveller on horseback &c.; hence (sub. חמור) an ass used for marching through the desert alongside of (and sometimes tied to) the camel.
units: Y. Sabb. V, 7ᵇ top מהו א׳ what is an ambates? חמר סלק the ass of the traveller (from Egypt to Asia). Y. Kel. VIII, 31ᶜ אבהנוס, אבחטס (corr. acc.). V. לִיבְדְּקוֹס.
